query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.nameJa, ds.sourceUrl
FROM cards c
JOIN dataSources ds ON ds.cardId = c.id
WHERE (c.name LIKE '%Satoshi%' OR c.nameJa LIKE '%サトシ%' OR c.name LIKE '%SM-P%076%')
  AND ds.source = 'snkrdunk'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.nameJa, ds.sourceUrl
FROM cards c
JOIN dataSources ds ON ds.cardId = c.id
WHERE ds.sourceUrl LIKE '%snkrdunk%'
  AND (c.name LIKE '%Pikachu%' OR c.nameJa LIKE '%ピカチュウ%')
  AND c.name LIKE '%SM-P%'
LIMIT 10;
